title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: pay-as-you-go billing for Other AI apps indicators (GCC, GCC High and DoD)
notes: claim 51: severity major on a rationale: risk rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
claim 58: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: the billing setup guidance omits the customer eligibility restriction on the documented subscription-linking procedure. Existing classic Azure Purview customers and customers using data security pay-as-you-go in free public preview have a different consent route. The roadmap facts and the principal billing and monitoring controls are otherwise supported.

claims.quote: Insider Risk Management indicators transitioning to a pay-as-you-go pricing model: “Entering risky prompt in Other AI apps”.

claims.where: Scope; controls[1].note; Governance guidance: Before rollout and At rollout
claims.claim: The subscription-based enablement procedure and its prerequisites are presented as the pay-as-you-go setup procedure without a customer-category restriction.
claims.quote: Applies to: Existing Azure Purview customers who are using the classic data governance pricing model. Microsoft Purview customers using Data Security pay-as-you-go features in free public preview. ... Settings > Account overview ... Select Review Consent
claims.fix: Qualify the Scope prerequisites, controls[1].note and subscription-linking checklist instructions with: 'This subscription-based procedure applies to organisations that are not current Azure Purview customers using the classic data governance pricing model.' For existing classic Azure Purview customers or customers using Data Security pay-as-you-go features in free public preview, replace the linking instruction with: 'Use Microsoft Purview portal > Settings > Account overview > Review Consent to consent to the pay-as-you-go model.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/purview-payg-consent-based-enablement and retain the Global Administrator and preview qualifications. Do not present either flow as confirmed for the government-cloud rollout.
